strongest_angle: Arthur Conan Doyle originally published A Study in Scarlet in December 1887 in Beeton's Christmas Annual after relinquishing all rights for just £25.

key_facts.fact: December 1887 saw the publication of the first of sixty tales featuring Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson in Beeton's Christmas Annual.
key_facts.source_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

key_facts.fact: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle agreed to relinquish all rights to the story A Study in Scarlet in exchange for the sum of £25.
key_facts.source_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

key_facts.fact: Ward, Lock & Co. published the First British Book Edition of A Study in Scarlet in 1888 following its initial magazine appearance.
J.B. Lippincott Company published the First American Book Edition of A Study in Scarlet in the year 1890.
